notes.title: Update 4/12
notes.content: Buffed rail, pulse, beam, and cinder weapons. Increased player speed. Repositioned some UI elements. Increased player health.

tags.balance_change: Buffed rail, pulse, beam, and cinder weapons.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck on a planet if it leaves the boss ring after the ring has been activated. The player will now be unable to land on a planet outside of an activated boss ring.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck on a planet if it leaves the boss ring after the ring has been activated.

notes.title: vSync
notes.content: Added a menu option to disable vSync. Disabling vSync will cap the framerate at 60, rather than trying to run the game at your monitor's refresh rate.

tags.feature: Added a menu option to disable vSync.

notes.title: Update 9/30
notes.content:
[h1]Nebula[/h1]

Added Nebula, which are giant pockets of colorful gas, at the center of which you can be sure to find rewards...

[h1]Mechanized Planets[/h1]

Added Mechanized Planets, which offer damage upgrades to be mined and large mineral rewards if you have the firepower to destroy them. Watch out for their defenses, though...

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]

Planets can now be slightly larger than before.
Set default solar nova max ammo to 3.

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
[h1]We Have Achievements![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/1694740/85f2814ab15fd3a92770ba672f1f233cc0e533b6.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Introducing 18 new Steam achievements! These have been a lot of fun to create, and I hope they are fun to chase down and complete.

[*] Achievements will be updated when a run completes, and most will take into account progress made before achievements were implemented.

[*] If you want to reset all your stats using the "Delete Save Data" button, this will also reset your achievements and stats relating to achievements. I do this to leave as much control in the hands of you, the player, as possible. If you would rather reset your stats without removing the achievements you previously earned, let me know! I am open to changing this implementation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9/25
notes.content:
[h1]Enemies:[/h1]
[list]
[*] tuned level 3 bosses to make them more worthy
[*] added 6 new enemy variants with "beam" style attacks
[/list]
[h1]Weapons:[/h1]
[list]
[*] cinder base cooldown reduced
[*] improved the starting range of shard and laser
[*] base damage upgrades improved for several weapons
[/list]
[h1]Misc:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed "Hungry" difficulty level (start with no lifesteal) for being game-breakingly unfun. Forced the player to rely on RNG for health regen.
[*] Reduced enemy damage scaling on successive loops through the game.
[/list]
